changeManifest._note: THE FIVE DELEGATING HOME OPS (ODQ §934.47 add. 10, ratifying the lane's pre-declared line): rename-faction, rename-npc, rename-settlement (§12.3, each running the EXISTING cascade), set-world-fact (§14, DECLARATION ONLY — rederive and the pins are EM-B2's) and schedule-event (§18, the nineteenth HOME op: requires NOTHING, `when` at or after the next tick, the event drawn from the pulse's own catalogue and never free text). ONE BEHAVIOUR FAMILY: ops whose work belongs to another module. ⛔ THE THREE RENAMES WRITE NO NAME FIELD — they declare a writer and delegate; C2 scans for a planted assignment to prove it. `newName` is kind:'free' and that is correct, not a lapse: a name is the estate's one free-cascade field — typeable, but a change is this typed op running the cascade, so the freedom is in the value and the safety in the delegation. ⛔⛔ THE FILE CAP, RE-MEASURED AFTER THE SPLIT THE CHAIR RATIFIED: B1a's fourteen rows come to ≈213-227 of 250 (the split worked for B1a alone), but appending these five puts operations.js at ≈258-277. SIX ARMS (C1-C6) APPENDED to EM-B1a's single literal describe — straight-line `it`, no .each / runIf / nested describe (§P3.4). C5 pins the `when` floor and asserts NO CLAMP: scheduling into the past is rejected with a named error, never silently moved, because a clamp would apply a decree at a tick the DM did not choose. ⚠ NO NEW tests/lint FILE APPEARS, so per the chair's condition NO mutation-coverage row is owed.

acceptanceCases.case: MAIN AND THE COMBINED TOTALITY RE-ASSERTED: OP_TYPES holds exactly THIRTY — EM-B1a's fourteen home rows plus EM-B1b's eleven off-stage rows plus these five — set-equal both directions with a full offender list, so a row dropped by any of the three packets reds here. THE RENAMES DELEGATE AND WRITE NO NAME — the prevention guard. Each of the three declares its target kind, a single required newName, stage:'home', consequence:'home', and its declared writer BY NAME (factionRenameChanges, npcRenameChanges, renameSettlementImpl). A source scan proves this module writes no name field and re-implements no path listed in FACTION_RENAME_SURFACES or NPC_RENAME_SURFACES, with the matcher proved live on a planted assignment.

set-world-fact NAMES EM-P3's HOME AND RESOLVES NOTHING. `fact` validates against exactly the seven world-fact keys; `value` presence is required; the per-fact pool mapping cites WORLD_FACT_SOURCES and is asserted to contain NO SECOND COPY of any option list. A source scan proves no rederive call and no pool import — the design §14 engine stays EM-B2's.

schedule-event READS THE CATALOGUE AND REFUSES THE NON-AUTHORABLE. Its event values derive from AUTHORITATIVE_CANON_EVENT_TYPES MINUS NON_AUTHORABLE_EVENTS, read BY REFERENCE — a source scan proves neither list is re-typed. 'CUT_TRADE_ROUTE', which is authoritative AND non-authorable, is asserted REJECTED; 'CREATE_ROUTE' accepted; a free-text event rejected. Anchored by the accepted case first.

THE `when` FLOOR, AND NO CLAMP. `when` at nextTick and after validates; `when` before nextTick returns { ok: false } with a named error and the returned op is asserted UNCHANGED — never silently clamped, because a clamp would apply a decree at a tick the DM did not choose. A non-integer `when` is rejected.

PURITY, DORMANCY AND THE IMPORT FENCE. makeOp/validateOp stay pure over the new rows (the input payload proved unmutated against a pre-call clone); the module's import list contains NONE of a PRNG, rngContext, src/store/**, src/components/**, or src/domain/factionRename.js — it names the cascade as DATA and never imports it; a source scan finds ZERO importers of the new leaf, with guard-the-guard arms on both the walk and the matcher.
